definitions.explanation: Lacking courage, easily frightened, or hesitant to take risks.

examples.japanese: {臆病|おくびょう}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}したい。
examples.english: I want to fix my timid personality.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{臆病|おくびょう}で、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怖|こわ}⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧。
examples.english: This dog is timid and is afraid of loud sounds.

examples.japanese: {臆病|おくびょう}⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{吹|ふ}かれて→吹く：02445_fuku⟧、⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I got cold feet and gave up on the challenge.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{臆|おく} (hesitate) + {病|びょう} (illness, condition) - literally "condition of hesitation"

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {臆病|おくびょう}{者|もの} - coward
- {臆病|おくびょう}⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{吹|ふ}かれる→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ - to get cold feet (lit. blown by the wind of cowardice)
- {臆病|おくびょう}な⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧ - timid heart

USAGE:
Generally used negatively, though sometimes sympathetically.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大胆|だいたん}→大胆：07609_daitan⟧ - bold, daring
- ⟦{勇敢|ゆうかん}→勇敢：07637_yuukan⟧ - brave, courageous

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{弱虫|よわむし}→弱虫：20009_yowamushi⟧ - weakling, coward (informal)
- {怖|こわ}⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧ - scaredy-cat
